  ShowAsBuilder (a,b,c,d) where
  IL(showAsBuilder) = showTup4AsBuilder

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

v2BSpcSepLn, v2BSpcSep, v2BConcat, v2BLines ::
  (VG.Vector v a, ShowAsBuilder a)
  => v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepLn) = v2BSpcSepLnWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BSpcSep) = v2BSpcSepWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BConcat) = v2BConcatWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BLines) = v2BLinesWith showAsBuilder


v2BSpcSepLnWith, v2BSpcSepWith, v2BConcatWith, v2BLinesWith ::
  (VG.Vector v a)
  => (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepLnWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith $ BS.singleton '\n'
IL(v2BSpcSepWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith BS.empty
IL(v2BConcatWith) showFct = VG.foldr ((<>) . showFct) mempty
IL(v2BLinesWith) showFct
  = VG.foldr (\ a -> (showFct a <>) . (BSB.char7 '\n' <>)) mempty


v2BSpcSepPostf :: (VG.Vector v a, ShowAsBuilder a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepPostf) = (`v2BSpcSepPostfWith` showAsBuilder)

v2BSpcSepPostfWith :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepPostfWith) = vecToBuilder BS.empty $ BS.singleton ' '

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

IL(evalVals) :: [a] -> [a]
evalVals xs = build $ \c n -> foldr (c $!) n xs
IL(forceVals) :: (NFData a) => [a] -> [a]
forceVals xs = build $ \c n -> foldr (c $!!) n xs

IL(vMapFoldl) :: (VG.Vector v b, VG.Vector v c) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> v b -> v c
vMapFoldl f a
  = VG.unstream . VFB.inplace (streamMapFoldl f a) id . VG.stream

streamMapFoldl :: (Functor m) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> VFSM.Stream m b -> VFSM.Stream m c
{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \r -> case r of
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

IL(svecToBS) :: VS.Vector Word8 -> BS.ByteString
svecToBS vec = BSU.fromForeignPtr ptr 0 len
  where (ptr, len) = VS.unsafeToForeignPtr0 vec

main :: IO ()
main = do
  [n,tMax] <- map readInt . words <$> getLine
  stores <- do
    stores <- VU.unsafeThaw =<< getVecURest n (liftA2 (,) rIntL rIntL)
    vait_sortBy
      (\(a0,b0) (a1,b1) -> compare (a1*(b0+1)) (a0*(b1+1))
                           <> compare b0 b1) stores
    VU.unsafeFreeze stores
  let (nonzero,zero) = VU.span ((/=0) . fst) stores
      sumZero = VU.scanl' (+) 0 $ VU.map (+1) $ snd $ VU.unzip zero
      nonZeroRes = VU.foldl'
        (\ !prev (!a,!b) ->
           VU.zipWith min prev $ VU.cons 0 $ VU.map (\t -> (a+1)*(t+1)+b) prev)
        (VU.cons (0::Int) $ VU.replicate (floorLog2 (tMax+1)) (1+tMax))
        nonzero
  let res = VU.maximum $ (`VU.imap` nonZeroRes) $ \ !i !tEnd ->
        if tEnd > tMax then 0 else i + findIdxLeqSorted sumZero (tMax-tEnd)
  print res
  return ()

findIdxLeqSorted :: (VG.Vector v a, Ord a) => v a -> a -> Int
{-# INLINE findIdxLeqSorted #-}
findIdxLeqSorted = findIdxLeqSortedBy compare

findIdxGeqSorted :: (VG.Vector v a, Ord a) => v a -> a -> Int
{-# INLINE findIdxGeqSorted #-}
findIdxGeqSorted = findIdxGeqSortedBy compare

findIdxLeqSortedBy :: VG.Vector v a => (a -> a -> Ordering) -> v a -> a -> Int
{-# INLINE findIdxLeqSortedBy #-}
findIdxLeqSortedBy cmp vec a
  = binSearchLeq ((/=GT) . (`cmp` a) . VG.unsafeIndex vec) (-1) (VG.length vec)

findIdxGeqSortedBy :: VG.Vector v a => (a -> a -> Ordering) -> v a -> a -> Int
{-# INLINE findIdxGeqSortedBy #-}
findIdxGeqSortedBy cmp vec a
  = binSearchGeq ((/=LT) . (`cmp` a) . VG.unsafeIndex vec) (-1) (VG.length vec)


binSearchLeq,binSearchGeq :: (Int -> Bool) -> Int -> Int -> Int
{-# INLINE binSearchLeq #-}
binSearchLeq f = \le gt -> runIdentity $ binSearchLeqM (return . f) le gt
{-# INLINE binSearchGeq #-}
binSearchGeq f = \le gt -> runIdentity $ binSearchGeqM (return . f) le gt

binSearchLeqM :: (Monad m) => (Int -> m Bool) -> Int -> Int -> m Int
{-# INLINE binSearchLeqM #-}
binSearchLeqM f = go
  where
    go le gt | gt - le <= 1 = return le
             | otherwise = do
                 let !mid = le + (gt - le) `shiftR` 1
                 test <- f mid
                 if test then go mid gt else go le mid

binSearchGeqM :: (Monad m) => (Int -> m Bool) -> Int -> Int -> m Int
{-# INLINE binSearchGeqM #-}
binSearchGeqM f = go
  where
    go lt ge | ge - lt <= 1 = return ge
             | otherwise = do
                 let !mid = lt + (ge - lt) `shiftR` 1
                 test <- f mid
                 if test then go lt mid else go mid ge


floorLog2 :: Int -> Int
floorLog2 x = finiteBitSize x - countLeadingZeros x - 1

#define FILTER \
  | len < 2   = return ()\
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
#define FILTERED FILTER | otherwise

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

vah_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

vah_heapify :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
    len = u - l
    loop k | k < 0 = return ()
    loop k = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
      vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

vah_pop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

vah_popTo :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

vah_sortHeap :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByIndex #-}

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

streamMapFoldl :: (Functor m) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> VFSM.Stream m b -> VFSM.Stream m c
{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \r -> case r of
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

      sumZero = VU.reverse $ VU.scanl' (+) 0 $ VU.map (+1) $ snd $ VU.unzip zero
      nonZeroRes = VU.foldl'
        (\ !prev (!a,!b) ->
           (\v -> if VU.unsafeLast v > tMax then VU.unsafeInit v else v)
           $ VU.zipWith min (VU.snoc prev maxBound)
           $ VU.cons 0 $ VU.map (\t -> (a+1)*(t+1)+b) prev)
        (VU.singleton (0::Int))
        nonzero
  let res = VU.maximum $ VU.imap (+)
        $ vMapFoldl (\ !vec !tEnd ->
                       let !(_,!next) = VU.span (> tMax - tEnd) vec
                       in (,next) $! VU.length next - 1)
            sumZero nonZeroRes
  print res
  return ()

#define FILTER \
  | len < 2   = return ()\
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
#define FILTERED FILTER | otherwise

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

vah_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

vah_heapify :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
    len = u - l
    loop k | k < 0 = return ()
    loop k = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
      vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

vah_pop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

vah_popTo :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

vah_sortHeap :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByIndex #-}

-- | A type of comparisons between two values of a given type.
type Comparison e = e -> e -> Ordering

vac_midPoint :: Int -> Int -> Int
vac_midPoint a b =
  fromIntegral $ (toWord a + toWord b) `div` 2
  where
    toWord :: Int -> Word
    toWord = fromIntegral
{-# INLINE vac_midPoint #-}

#undef vec_writes2
#undef vec_writes3
#undef vec_writes4
#undef FILTERED
#undef FILTER

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

v2BSpcSepLn, v2BSpcSep, v2BConcat, v2BLines ::
  (VG.Vector v a, ShowAsBuilder a)
  => v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepLn) = v2BSpcSepLnWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BSpcSep) = v2BSpcSepWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BConcat) = v2BConcatWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BLines) = v2BLinesWith showAsBuilder


v2BSpcSepLnWith, v2BSpcSepWith, v2BConcatWith, v2BLinesWith ::
  (VG.Vector v a)
  => (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepLnWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith $ BS.singleton '\n'
IL(v2BSpcSepWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith BS.empty
IL(v2BConcatWith) showFct = VG.foldr ((<>) . showFct) mempty
IL(v2BLinesWith) showFct
  = VG.foldr (\ a -> (showFct a <>) . (BSB.char7 '\n' <>)) mempty


v2BSpcSepPostf :: (VG.Vector v a, ShowAsBuilder a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepPostf) = (`v2BSpcSepPostfWith` showAsBuilder)

v2BSpcSepPostfWith :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepPostfWith) = vecToBuilder BS.empty $ BS.singleton ' '

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}

  where

(defconstant +inf+ #x7fffffff)

(defun main ()
  (declare #.OPT
           (inline sort))
  (let* ((n (read))
         (limit (read))
         (bs (make-array n :element-type 'uint32 :fill-pointer 0))
         (abs (make-array n :element-type '(cons uint31 uint31) :fill-pointer 0)))
    (declare (uint31 n limit))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let ((a (read-fixnum))
            (b (read-fixnum)))
        (if (zerop a)
            (vector-push (+ b 1) bs)
            (vector-push (cons a b) abs))))
    (setq bs (sort bs #'<))
    (setq abs (sort abs
                    (lambda (node1 node2)
                      (let ((a1 (car node1))
                            (b1 (cdr node1))
                            (a2 (car node2))
                            (b2 (cdr node2)))
                        (declare (uint31 a1 b1 a2 b2))
                        (<= (* a2 (+ b1 1)) (* a1 (+ b2 1)))))))
    (let* ((n1 (length abs))
           (n2 (length bs))
           (cumuls (make-array (+ n2 1) :element-type 'uint31 :initial-element 0))
           (dp (make-array '(200001 31) :element-type 'uint31 :initial-element +inf+)))
      (setf (aref dp 0 0) 0)
      (dotimes (i n2)
        (setf (aref cumuls (+ i 1))
              (min +inf+ (+ (aref cumuls i) (aref bs i)))))
      (dotimes (x n1)
        (destructuring-bind (a . b) (aref abs x)
          (declare (uint31 a b))
          (dotimes (y 31)
            (minf (aref dp (+ x 1) y) (aref dp x y))
            (when (< y 30)
              (minf (aref dp (+ x 1) (+ y 1))
                    (+ b (* (+ a 1) (+ (aref dp x y) 1))))))))
      (let ((res 0))
        (declare (uint31 res))
        (loop for y from 30 downto 0
              for pos = n2
              do (loop for x from n1 downto 0
                       do (loop until (or (<= (+ (aref dp x y) (aref cumuls pos)) limit)
                                          (zerop pos))
                                do (decf pos))
                          (when (<= (+ (aref dp x y) (aref cumuls pos)) limit)
                            (maxf res (+ y pos)))))
        (println res)))))

def min_store(t, s_i, ab, N):  # 現在の時刻, お店, お店リスト, お店数
    if N == 1:
        min_t = ab[0][0] * t + ab[0][1] + 1
        buy_j = 1
    elif s_i + 1 == N:
        min_t = ab[s_i - 1][0] * t + ab[s_i - 1][1] + 1  # s_iから一つ移動したお店での購入時間
        buy_j = s_i-1
    else:
        min_t = ab[s_i+1][0] * t + ab[s_i+1][1] + 1  # s_iから一つ移動したお店での購入時間
        buy_j = s_i+1
    t += 1
    for j in range(1, N):
        if t != 0:
            if ab[j][0] * t + ab[j][1] + 1 < min_t:
                min_t = ab[j][0] * t + ab[j][1] + t
                buy_j = j
        else:
            pass
    next_t = min_t
    return next_t, buy_j  # 購入後の時間, 買えたお店

    coef_0.sort()

    dp = [inf] * (L + 1)
    dp[0] = 0
    for coef, const in ps:
        for visited in reversed(range(L)):
            dp[visited + 1] = min(
                dp[visited + 1],
                (dp[visited] + 1) * (coef + 1) + const
            )

    def accumulate(a):
        s = 0
        yield s  # start=x->0
        for x in a:
            s += x
            yield s

    *acc, = accumulate(coef_0)

    ans = {0}

    for visited, consumption_time in enumerate(dp):

        while cnt > 0 and acc[cnt] > rest:  # bisect_right->しゃくとり

def solve(n, t, ab_list):
    a0b_list = [ab[1] for ab in ab_list if ab[0] == 0]
    apb_list = [ab for ab in ab_list if ab[0] > 0]
    a0b_list = sorted(a0b_list)
    apb_list = sorted(apb_list, key=lambda x: - x[0] / (x[1] + 1))
    # DP
    m = len(apb_list)
    dp = [[t + 1] * 30 for _ in range(m + 1)]
    for i in range(m + 1):
        dp[i][0] = 0
    for i in range(m):
        for k in range(1, 30):
            ti = dp[i][k - 1] + 1
            a, b = apb_list[i]
            dp[i + 1][k] = min(dp[i][k], ti + a * ti + b)
    a0b_list_cum_sum = [0]
    s = 0
    for b in a0b_list:
        s += b + 1
        a0b_list_cum_sum.append(s)

    res = 0

    for k in range(len(a0b_list_cum_sum)):
        for p in range(30):
            if dp[m][p] + a0b_list_cum_sum[k] <= t:
                res = max(res, k + p)

    return res

import sys
import math
import itertools
import bisect

INF = int(1e18)
T_MAX = int(1e9)

def main():
    N, T = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    shops = [tuple(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(N)]

    shops.sort(key=lambda x: x[0] / (x[0] + x[1] + 1), reverse=True)
    nnz = sum(1 for _ in itertools.takewhile(lambda x: x[0] > 0, shops))

    dp = [[0] + [INF] * int(math.log2(T_MAX)) for _ in range(nnz + 1)]
    for i in range(1, len(dp)):
        for c in range(1, len(dp[i])):
            a, b = shops[i - 1]
            t = dp[i - 1][c - 1] + 1
            dp[i][c] = min(dp[i - 1][c], t + t * a + b)

    rs = list(itertools.accumulate(1 + b for _, b in shops[nnz:]))
    ans = max(c + bisect.bisect(rs, T - dp[-1][c])
            for c in range(len(dp[-1])) if dp[-1][c] <= T)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

B += 1

def dp(items, size_limit):
    n = len(items)
    flag = [[10**10]*(size_limit+1)for i in range(n+1)]
    table = [[0]*(size_limit+1)for i in range(n+1)]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        target = items[i-1]
        w = target[0] * i + target[1] + 1
        for j in range(1,size_limit+1):
            yellow = table[i-1][j]
            table[i][j] = yellow
            if w > size_limit+0.5:
                continue
            pink = table[i-1][j-w]
            include_this = w + pink
            table[i][j] = max(yellow, include_this)
            flag[i][j] = include_this > yellow
    res = 0
    i = n
    j = size_limit
    while i > 0 and j > 0:
        if flag[i][j] is True:
            res += 1
            j -= w
        i -= 1
    return res

import sys
import math
import itertools

def required_visit_time(t, shop):
    a, b = shop
    return int((t - b) / (a + 1)) - 1

# shops はソート済み
def calc_dp_time(T, shops):
    t = T
    for s in shops:
        t = required_visit_time(t, s)
    return t

def main():
    N, T = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    shops = list(tuple(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(N))

    shops.sort(key=lambda x: x[0] / (x[0] + x[1] + 1), reverse=True)
    dpmemo = None

    def dp(i, t):
        assert i >= 0
        assert t >= 0

        if i == 0:
            return 0

        if (i, t) in dpmemo:
            return dpmemo[i, t]

        h = i - 1
        r = required_visit_time(t, shops[h])
        n = max(dp(h, r) + 1, dp(h, t)) if r >= 0 else dp(h, t)
        dpmemo[i, t] = n
        return n

    dpmax = sum(1 for _ in itertools.takewhile(lambda x: x[0] > 0, shops))

    # dp(dpmax, t) | t = T と同じ値を得られる最小の t を二分探索
    dpmemo = {}
    ans = dp(dpmax, T)
    l = 0
    r = T + 1
    while l + 1 < r:
        m = int((l + r) / 2)
        dpmemo = {}
        n = dp(dpmax, m)
        if n < ans:
            l = m
        else:
            r = m

    t = r
    for i in range(dpmax, N):
        _, b = shops[i]
        t += 1 + b
        if t > T:
            break
        ans += 1

    print(ans)

N, T = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.readline().split()))
A, B = list(zip(*[map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.readline().split()) for _ in range(N)]))

A = np.array(A, dtype=int)
B = np.array(B, dtype=int)

# 移動時間を考えなくて良いようにする
A += 1
B += 1
T += 1

# 使う店を決めたとき、(a - 1) / b の大きい順に使うのが最適
I = np.argsort((A - 1) / B)[::-1]
A = A[I]
B = B[I]

idx_zero = np.searchsorted((A == 1).astype(int), 1, side='left')
MAX_COUNT = (10 ** 9).bit_length() + 2
# dp[i][x]: i まで見て、x こ使うときの t の最小値
dp = np.full((idx_zero + 1, MAX_COUNT), IINF, dtype=int)
dp[:, 0] = 1
for x in range(MAX_COUNT - 1):
    dp[1:, x + 1] = dp[:-1, x] * A[:idx_zero] + B[:idx_zero]
    dp[:, x + 1] = np.minimum.accumulate(dp[:, x + 1])
    dp[:, x + 1] = np.minimum(dp[:, x + 1], T + 1)

#: :type: list of int
B_A0 = np.msort(B[idx_zero:]).tolist()

    while i < len(B_A0) and t + B_A0[i] <= T:
        t += B_A0[i]
        i += 1
        cnt += 1
    ans = max(ans, cnt)
print(ans)

    """その時間での最小の待ち時間とインデックスを返す"""

    for i in range(len(array)):
        min_time = min(min_time, array[i][0]*t + array[i][1])
        if min_time == array[i][0]*t + array[i][1]:
            idx = i
    return min_time, idx

def main():
    from operator import itemgetter
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.readline

    inf = 1 << 30
    L = 30

    N, T = map(int, input().split())

    ps = []
    coef_0 = []
    for _ in range(N):
        a, b = map(int, input().split())
        if a == 0:
            coef_0.append(b + 1)
        else:
            ps.append((a / (b + 1), a, b))  # namedtupleやめた,sort_key,coef,const

    ps.sort(key=itemgetter(0), reverse=True)
    coef_0.sort()

    dp = [inf] * (L + 1)
    dp[0] = 0
    for _, coef, const in ps:
        for visited in reversed(range(L)):
            dp[visited + 1] = min(
                dp[visited + 1],
                (dp[visited] + 1) * (coef + 1) + const
            )

    def accumulate(a):
        s = 0
        yield s  # start=x->0
        for x in a:
            s += x
            yield s

    *acc, = accumulate(coef_0)

    ans = {0}
    cnt = len(acc) - 1
    for visited, consumption_time in enumerate(dp):
        rest = T - consumption_time
        if rest < 0: continue  # le->lt
        while cnt > 0 and acc[cnt] > rest:  # bisect_right->しゃくとり
            cnt -= 1
        ans.add(visited + cnt)
    print(max(ans))

import sys
import math
import itertools

def required_visit_time(t, shop):
    a, b = shop
    return int((t - b) / (a + 1)) - 1

# shops はソート済み
def calc_dp_time(T, shops):
    t = T
    for s in shops:
        t = required_visit_time(t, s)
    return t

def main():
    N, T = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    shops = list(tuple(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(N))

    shops.sort(key=lambda x: x[0] / (x[0] + x[1] + 1), reverse=True)
    dpmemo = {}

    def dp(i, t):
        assert i >= 0
        assert t >= 0

        if i == 0:
            return 0

        if (i, t) in dpmemo:
            return dpmemo[i, t]

        h = i - 1
        r = required_visit_time(t, shops[h])
        n = max(dp(h, r) + 1, dp(h, t)) if r >= 0 else dp(h, t)
        dpmemo[i, t] = n
        return n

    dpmax = sum(1 for _ in itertools.takewhile(lambda x: x[0] > 0, shops))

    # dp(dpmax, t) | t = T と同じ値を得られる最小の t を二分探索
    ans = dp(dpmax, T)
    l = 0
    r = T + 1
    while l + 1 < r:
        m = int((l + r) / 2)
        n = dp(dpmax, m)
        if n < ans:
            l = m
        else:
            r = m

    t = r
    for i in range(dpmax, N):
        _, b = shops[i]
        t += 1 + b
        if t > T:
            break
        ans += 1

    print(ans)

import sys
import math
import itertools

def required_visit_time(t, shop):
    a, b = shop
    return int((t - b) / (a + 1)) - 1

# shops はソート済み
def calc_dp_time(T, shops):
    t = T
    for s in shops:
        t = required_visit_time(t, s)
    return t

def main():
    N, T = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    shops = list(tuple(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(N))

    shops.sort(key=lambda x: x[0] / (x[0] + x[1] + 1), reverse=True)
    dpmemo = {}

    def dp(i, t):
        assert i >= 0
        assert t >= 0

        if i == 0:
            return 0

        if (i, t) in dpmemo:
            return dpmemo[i, t]

        h = i - 1
        r = required_visit_time(t, shops[h])
        n = max(dp(h, r) + 1, dp(h, t)) if r >= 0 else dp(h, t)
        dpmemo[i, t] = n
        return n

    #
    # 解に含まれ得る a=0 要素を二分探索
    #
    dpmax = sum(1 for _ in itertools.takewhile(lambda x: x[0] > 0, shops))
    l = dpmax
    r = N + 1
    while l + 1 < r:

        else:

    for i in range(l, dpmax - 1, -1):
        t = calc_dp_time(T, shops[dpmax:i])
        n = dp(dpmax, t) + (i - dpmax)
        if n <= ans:
            break
        ans = n

    print(ans)

def solve(n, t, ab_list):
    a0b_list = [ab[1] for ab in ab_list if ab[0] == 0]
    apb_list = [ab for ab in ab_list if ab[0] > 0]
    a0b_list = sorted(a0b_list)
    apb_list = sorted(apb_list, key=lambda x: - x[0] / (x[1] + 1))
    # DP
    m = len(apb_list)
    dp = [[t + 1] * 30 for _ in range(m + 1)]
    for i in range(m + 1):
        dp[i][0] = 0
    for i in range(m):
        for k in range(1, 30):
            ti = dp[i][k - 1] + 1
            a, b = apb_list[i]
            dp[i + 1][k] = min(dp[i][k], ti + a * ti + b)
    a0b_list_cum_sum = [0]
    s = 0
    for b in a0b_list:
        s += b + 1
        a0b_list_cum_sum.append(s)

    res = 0

    for k in range(len(a0b_list_cum_sum)):
        for p in range(30):
            if dp[m][p] + a0b_list_cum_sum[k] <= t:
                res = max(res, k + p)
                
    return res

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.readline

    inf = 1 << 30
    L = 30

    N, T = map(int, input().split())

    ps = []
    coef_0 = []
    for _ in range(N):
        a, b = map(int, input().split())
        if a == 0:
            coef_0.append(b + 1)
        else:
            ps.append((a, b))  # namedtupleやめた,coef,const

    ps.sort(key=lambda p: p[0] / (p[1] + 1), reverse=True)
    coef_0.sort()

    dp = [inf] * (L + 1)
    dp[0] = 0
    for coef, const in ps:
        for visited in reversed(range(L)):
            dp[visited + 1] = min(
                dp[visited + 1],
                (dp[visited] + 1) * (coef + 1) + const
            )

    def accumulate(a):
        s = 0
        yield s  # start=x->0
        for x in a:
            s += x
            yield s

    *acc, = accumulate(coef_0)

    ans = {0}
    cnt = len(acc) - 1
    for visited, consumption_time in enumerate(dp):
        rest = T - consumption_time
        if rest < 0: break  # le->lt,continue->break,restは狭義単調減少
        while cnt > 0 and acc[cnt] > rest:  # bisect_right->しゃくとり
            cnt -= 1
        ans.add(visited + cnt)
    print(max(ans))

    a1, b1 = store1

    return -1 if a2 * (b1 + 1) <= a1 * (b2 + 1) else 1
